name: ME Requester
purpose: Placeable block from this mod; it may be decorative, functional, or a recipe ingredient depending on JEI/EMI uses.
acquire: Craft or process it with crafting shaped. Press R on the item in JEI/EMI for the exact ATM10 recipe.
use: Place it in-world; press U in JEI/EMI to see recipes, multiblock roles, or crafting uses.

name: ME Requester Terminal
purpose: Functional block for automation, storage, power, fluids, or item processing.
acquire: Craft or process it with crafting shapeless. Press R on the item in JEI/EMI for the exact ATM10 recipe.
use: Place it, provide required power/items/fluids, configure sides if available, and use JEI/EMI recipes to feed it.

name: Wireless Requester Terminal
purpose: Crafting or processing material used in this mod's recipes and upgrade chains.
acquire: Craft or process it with crafting shaped. Press R on the item in JEI/EMI for the exact ATM10 recipe.
use: Place it, provide required power/items/fluids, configure sides if available, and use JEI/EMI recipes to feed it.
